name: Harness Code
description: Every message: the agent starts with the Harness Code tools before grep or file reads.

action.text: Your first tool call on every message MUST be a Harness Code tool, before any grep, find, ls or file read, with project_path (the repository root): code_map for an area (focus = the path the request names), code_symbol when you know a name. Memory and knowledge searches go in that same first batch. Then use code_impact before changing a signature or behaviour and code_path for how A reaches B. Use grep and file reads only for literal text and for details the graph does not show. Status line: "Code Graph: code_map ui/src/hooks".
